verdict.rationale: Phaser's installation docs describe an official CLI that offers an interactive selection of official project templates and demo games, then downloads and configures the chosen package. That is a real first-party CLI, but its documented scope is limited to interactive project scaffolding. The MCP server is a separate capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: any CLI functionality beyond scaffolding (build, run, publish or asset commands), a non-interactive or scriptable mode suited to AI agents, the command name and reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
